name: Iori
message: 「Nah, Setsugekka and Momiji are... I have no idea where they went.」
Once back in the classroom, I finished giving Asahi instructions on her training menu.
I took a lunch break and then tried looking for Setsugekka and Momiji again, but there was no sign of either of them.
There are always a few security drones flying around the school grounds, and it's possible to pinpoint students using their footage.
However, neither Setsugekka nor Momiji turned up in the footage.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, it’s always been pretty hit-or-miss anyway.」
A few drones could never hope to cover the vast grounds of the academy, and the area outside the school isn't subject to security surveillance.
On my way back toward the academy, I caught a glimpse of someone as I passed by the training ground.

name: Iori
message: 「What are they doing out in a place like that？」
There, in a patch of wild grass filled with pampas grass, was someone I recognized.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Oh, Muragaki-san.」
I called out to Keisetsu, who was standing in the field of pampas grass.

name: Iori
message: 「What are you doing in a place like this？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Just a little business negotiation.」

name: Iori
message: 「A business negotiation？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, I’m planning to consult with the landowner to see if they might be willing to sell me this land.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You could say today is for an on-site inspection.」

name: Iori
message: 「Buying land... that’s a pretty grand story.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Sumiyoshi Academic Island still has many undeveloped plots like this one.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I’m planning to buy a portion of it and construct a <d0038>mixed-use facility by the Kazamine Group</d>.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Residential and office spaces will be the main focus, but I’ll also ensure there are plenty of entertainment facilities.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「By including things like a movie theater, shopping mall, and party venues, I want to make it a place that many people can enjoy.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If everything goes smoothly, I think it will take shape in about seven years after construction begins.」

name: Iori
message: 「I, I see.」
The scale of the story was too big for me to keep up with.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Although, at this stage, it’s nothing more than a fantasy inside my head.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It will take a great deal of power to give this shape.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Fortunately, we have had many offers of cooperation, so I’m sure we’ll be able to make arrangements before long.」
I followed Keisetsu as she began to walk, exiting the pampas grass field.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「At present, almost the entirety of Sumiyoshi Academic Island is under the Suzakuin influence.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「We of the Kazamine family wish to use Murakumo Academy as a <d0039>bridgehead</d> to drive a wedge into Sumiyoshi Academic Island.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That is why Setsugekka and I are here now.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I heard that before.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I want Setsugekka to defeat Suzakuin Momiji at all costs.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「For that, Muragaki-san, your efforts are indispensable.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course, I’ll do everything I can. I have no intention of holding back.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「In that case, Muragaki-san, may I ask you a question？」
I nodded in response.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I get the feeling that Setsugekka is wary of you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Did something happen between you and her？」
*Wince.*

name: Iori
message: 「N-no... nothing at all.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Setsugekka reacted similarly to you just now.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What exactly are you hiding？」

name: Iori
message: 「What did she say, for her part？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「She said it was fine, and that it wouldn't be an issue, but...」
I see, so she hasn't told Keisetsu the truth.
Well, no matter how much they're twins who share the same blood, she couldn't exactly tell her 'I was seen by someone while masturbating,' could she.

name: Iori
message: 「There was a minor bit of trouble, but the parties involved have already resolved it.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What kind of trouble？」

name: Iori
message: 「You'll have to ask Setsugekka. I at least can't say it from my side.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hmmmmmm, I see. Understood.」
Ugh, I am being suspected like crazy...

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Personally, as long as it doesn't interfere with Setsugekka's training, I won't involve myself in whatever happens between the two of you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Am I correct in assuming that her training is currently proceeding without issue？」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Well... there might or might not be just a tiny bit of a hitch...」
Setsugekka keeps running away from me, saying she's embarrassed and all.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Sigh... That simply won't do, Muragaki-san.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Training Setsugekka so she can defeat Suzakuin Momiji.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「After all, that is the very reason you are here.」
What did she just say?

name: Iori
message: 「...Keisetsu, what do you know about me？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I believe I previously told you our reasons for coming to this academy.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「More precisely, three.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「First, to build credentials for myself and Setsugekka.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Being able to show that we achieved results at Murakumo Academy, which is under the Suzakuin Family's control, will surely prove useful later on.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Second, to assess the true state of the Suzakuin Family.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The Kazamine Group is devoting its full resources to investigating just how far the Suzakuin Family's influence extends.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Murakumo Academy is one of the targets of that investigation, and Setsugekka and I serve as part of the investigative team.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Naturally, we have sent investigators into other organizations as well. Including the Tenju Special Forces Group that you belong to, Muragaki-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「Are you sure it's okay to go blabbing something that important to me？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Of course. If it weren't, I wouldn't have spoken of it in the first place.」
...So she's already pulled strings behind the scenes. How shrewd.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Third, to build a track record for Setsugekka as a candidate for the next head of the Kazamine Family.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If Setsugekka can claim the title of Toujinegi, she will be a major step closer to becoming the family head.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「To achieve that, defeating Suzakuin Momiji is essential.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「She is certain to place near the top in this year's Martial Festival. Without defeating Suzakuin Momiji, winning the championship is out of the question.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I'd imagine so.」
Even with her current strength, Momiji is practically guaranteed a spot in the Martial Festival's main tournament. There's no doubt about that.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「However, in her current state, Setsugekka likely cannot defeat Suzakuin Momiji」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The key is whether or not Setsugekka can control her runaway power」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But it will be difficult for Setsugekka to gain that control on her own」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That is why a skilled instructor is required」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Initially, I intended to scout someone capable among the teachers here at Murakumo Academy」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「However, my expectations were off」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The quality of the teachers at Murakumo Academy was not as high as I had imagined」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Of course, there are extremely competent individuals among the faculty. But they are under the thumb of the Suzakuin family and were not worth trusting」
...I'm starting to get the picture.

name: Iori
message: 「So, is that why I was called here？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I selected someone from our candidate list who has few ties to the Suzakuin, is well-versed in the subtleties of the academy, and possesses undeniable skill in Jindou」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That said, there are plenty of people in this academy who are simply strong. What is important is that they be sincere and forward-thinking regarding their instruction」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「As I was searching for such a person, I arrived at you」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Your superior officer, <d0040>JGSDF Major Asagiri Midori</d>, tells me that you are a very dependable person who is great at looking after others」
Ah... I see, so that's it, is that how it is.

name: Iori
message: 「In short, it means even my company commander is one of Kazamine's people」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The Asagiri family came under the Kazamine Group's umbrella two years ago. There are many excellent people among them, and it has been a great help」
How can Keisetsu be so calm while exposing the inside story to me?
It's because my superior officer was a Kazamine person to begin with.

name: Iori
message: 「Meaning the client for this special assigned duty is you, Kazamine Keisetsu」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, that is what it amounts to」
...Things have suddenly started to smell fishy.
Keisetsu said this earlier.
『Instruct Setsugekka so she can defeat Suzakuin Momiji' 'That is why you are here』
The demand from my client, Keisetsu, is for me to use my position as a teacher to make Setsugekka beat Momiji.
There must be more to it than just teaching Setsugekka.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Is something wrong, Muragaki-san？ You have a scary look on your face」

name: Iori
message: 「Keisetsu, let me say this first」
I lock eyes with Keisetsu, who is smiling with perfect composure.

name: Iori
message: 「My mission is to instruct the students of Takamura Class as a teacher at Murakumo Academy.」

name: Iori
message: 「That is why I will treat the students of Takamura Class equally.」

name: Iori
message: 「I will neither give Setsugekka preferential treatment nor belittle Momiji.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you are expecting anything of the sort, you should fire me right now and find someone else.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Are you suggesting that, in your estimation, Setsugekka cannot surpass Suzakuin Momiji？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, Setsugekka has immense potential.」
If she can learn to manipulate that power she showed when she went berserk at her own will, she will become incredibly strong.

name: Iori
message: 「However, I will not play favorites. I want Setsugekka to become strong, and I want Momiji to become strong, too.」

name: Iori
message: 「Even if the result of that is that Setsugekka ends up unable to beat Momiji.」

name: Iori
message: 「It is true that I have no ties to the Suzakuin Family. But the same is true for the Kazamine Family.」

name: Iori
message: 「I will not take either side, nor do I intend to involve myself in your family squabbles.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you are going to entrust me with the instruction, I want you to understand that.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「And if I were to say that if you don't comply, the Kazamine family will crush you with all our might？」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll send every last one of you to an early grave. Don't underestimate Muragaki, the swordsman-slayer.」
For a moment, he glares at Keisetsu.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Heh, you're pure, aren't you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Just as Asagiri Midori said, you're sincere and simple-minded—perhaps too kind for a swordsman.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But that is a talent that surpasses everything else.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「No matter how overflowing with talent a person may be, if they lack sincerity, they have no value.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I like you, Muragaki Iori. I leave it to you.」

name: Iori
message: 「……Are you sure？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I hate worrying over things. It's a waste of time, isn't it？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I'm certain you will devote yourself entirely to Setsugekka's instruction.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「No matter what happens, you won't abandon Setsugekka, and you won't betray her.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, though I'll put everything I've got into instructing Suzakuin Momiji too.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That's a frustrating point, but it can't be helped.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I'll accept it as a testament to your sincerity in striving to remain fair.」

name: Iori
message: 「You're giving in awfully easily, considering you were just threatening to crush me a moment ago.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I only wanted to see your reaction. If a threat was enough to make you waver, I would've fired you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Anyone who caves to intimidation will easily betray you the moment a bigger threat comes along.」

name: Iori
message: 「Y-You were testing me...？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe, it was part of the hiring exam. Don't hold it against me.」
Good grief, I'm no match for her.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Well then, Mr. Muragaki, please take very good care of Setsugekka.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hold on a second.」
I call out to stop Keisetsu as she makes to leave.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Is there something else？」

name: Iori
message: 「I understand where you're coming from, and I promise I'll give my all to instructing Setsugekka.」

name: Iori
message: 「However, I intend to treat every student in Takamura Class equally.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You already told me that.」

name: Iori
message: 「And that includes you too, Keisetsu.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm going to treat you equally as well.」

name: Iori
message: 「It doesn't matter whether you're the next head of the Kazamine family or my client. You're a first-year at Murakumo Academy and a member of Takamura Class.」

name: Iori
message: 「So, Keisetsu, I want you to properly attend class too.」
At my words, a blank look appears on Keisetsu's face.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Pfft, hehehe... You're even more ridiculously earnest than I thought.」

name: Iori
message: 「I-I can't help it. It's just how I'm built.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Whether I'm there or not, what you have to do won't change, will it？」

name: Iori
message: 「What I do won't change, but everyone else will.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Why？」

name: Iori
message: 「The class will get bright and lively, and school life will become fun.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Is that important to Setsugekka？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, it's important.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hmm... That's an interesting way of thinking. Very well, I'll play along.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「However, if you're going to have me spend my time on this, I want you to prove your ability.」

name: Iori
message: 「My ability？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The last time everyone gathered in the classroom, it was a complete disaster, wasn't it？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ugh... Well, that was...」
There's no making excuses for that.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Persuading the Takamura Class students to attend class properly.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If you can do that, then I'll join you in this bright and lively school life you speak of.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Let's see what you can do. First, show me your leadership.」
With a challenging smile, Keisetsu turned her back on me.
